shots.headline: The Mile-High Tower
shots.narration: In 1956, Frank Lloyd Wright unveiled a skyscraper one mile tall.

shots.label: MASSING STUDY · ILLUSTRATIVE
shots.narration: He called it the Illinois. Five hundred and twenty-eight floors, reaching a full mile into the sky.
The tallest building standing today is only about half that height.

shots.label: MASSING STUDY · ILLUSTRATIVE
shots.narration: The Illinois was never built. This is roughly what it might have looked like.
